# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 40 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve's Lament; Seth Comforts Her

---

**40:1** Eve fell on her face and wept before the gate of paradise: 'O God, forgive me, for I have brought great sorrow upon all my children.'

**40:2** Seth came to Eve and comforted her: 'Mother, do not weep, for God is merciful to all who repent.'

**40:3** Eve said: 'O Seth, my son, who will comfort me in my old age? For I am alone.'

**40:4** Seth said: 'God will comfort you, mother, as he has comforted all who have called upon him.'

---
*SOPHIA: consensus rendering. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
